title: Odebu Akujo ni Tensei shitara, Nazeka Last Boss Oujisama ni Shuuchaku sareteimasu
englishTitle: The Final-Boss Prince Is Somehow Obsessed with the Chubby Villainess: Reincarnated Me
title_english: The Final-Boss Prince Is Somehow Obsessed with the Chubby Villainess: Reincarnated Me

synonyms: When I Reincarnated as a Chubby Villainess, For Some Reason, I'm Being Relentlessly Pursued by the Final Boss Prince!
alternative_titles.en: The Final-Boss Prince Is Somehow Obsessed with the Chubby Villainess: Reincarnated Me
alternative_titles.ja: おデブ悪女に転生したら、なぜかラスボス王子様に執着されています

synopsis:
After dying of illness, she has been reincarnated as Celine, the selfish, fat, villainous duchess, sister of the heroine of a popular novel. If she stays this way, she will be killed by the hero prince and die a miserable death, just as in the novel. She vows to reform herself with all her might and begins to struggle, but she finds herself caught up in unexpected doting and obsession! Will Celine be able to find "peaceful happiness"?

A fantasy love story about a reincarnation in another world where she is loved too much by a yandere.

(Source: NHN comico Corp.)
synopsis_es:
Tras morir de enfermedad, se ha reencarnado en Celine, la duquesa egoísta, gorda y villana, hermana de la heroína de una novela popular. Si permanece así, el príncipe héroe la matará y sufrirá una muerte miserable, tal como en la novela. Ella promete reformarse con todas sus fuerzas y comienza a luchar, ¡pero se encuentra atrapada en un cariño y una obsesión inesperados! ¿Podrá Celine encontrar la "felicidad pacífica"?

Una historia de amor de fantasía sobre una reencarnación en otro mundo donde un yandere la ama demasiado.

(Fuente: NHN cómico Corp.)
